page_title: StrokeMouse — 免费开源的 Mac 鼠标手势与触控板手势工具

sources.entry: StrokeMouse - Custom mouse gestures that can trigger keyboard shortcuts, open apps, perform window actions, run shell commands, or execute AppleScript after drawing a stroke. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Licoy/StrokeMouse) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: StrokeMouse
summary.one_liner: StrokeMouse is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that turns mouse strokes, side-button clicks, modifier-key drawing and multi-finger trackpad gestures into shortcuts, window actions, app launches and scripts.
use_cases: Trigger keyboard shortcuts by drawing strokes with the mouse
Remap mouse side buttons to back/forward or custom actions
Draw gestures without a mouse using a modifier key and trackpad
Open apps, URLs or run shell/AppleScript with a gesture
Control windows and Mission Control with trackpad or mouse gestures
summary.what_it_does: StrokeMouse lets you hold the right, middle or side mouse button and draw a stroke to trigger an action; each gesture can record one to five samples and is matched with elastic comparison. Single side- or middle-button clicks can be remapped to actions without drawing, with optional modifier variants. It also supports edge clicks and wheel-based scroll triggers, drawing with a single modifier key (Fn, Control, Option, Shift or Command) and moving the pointer on a trackpad, and about 40 experimental built-in trackpad gestures. Actions include system shortcuts, custom key combos, opening apps or URLs, window actions, media keys, and shell or AppleScript commands, with gestures scoped globally, per app group or per app.
notable: Open source under AGPL-3.0 on GitHub, no account or telemetry
Draw gestures with mouse buttons, side buttons, a modifier key, or trackpad multi-finger gestures
Per-app and per-window scoping for gestures and actions
caveats: Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later and Accessibility permission for global input and shortcuts
Trackpad gestures use Apple private MultitouchSupport framework and may break after macOS updates; marked experimental
Scripts run with the current user's permissions
